module: Manager of a rally loop: a mission that chains the start service, up to 4 road section/stage pairs (stageN_rallyRoadSection / stageN_rallyStage), a return road section and the service park. It builds the mission sequence from the mission's fgVariables, computes the schedule (time controls TC, SS start lines, stops), derives a linear list of events from it, keeps the rally clock (epoch), records penalties and timecards in a rallyEventLog, and provides stream data (getStreamData) for the interface. Instantiated by the gameplay_rallyLoop extension with (missionId, missionDir); the rally flowgraph nodes call it to record passages through the controls.
usage:
local mgr = require('gameplay_rally_loop_rallyLoopManager')(missionId, missionDir)
mgr:setClockPaused(false)
local ev = mgr:getEvents()[mgr:getNextEventIndex()]
print(ev.label, ev.time)
notes: The module returns a constructor; C:init(missionId, missionDir) is called automatically. If the mission has fgVariables, the sequence and schedule are computed in init; otherwise the sequence stays empty.

Clock (self.clock): in seconds in the rally's epoch. It is negative before the rally start (start = next full minute after the environment time + 120 s), is 0 at the rally start then increases. It starts paused (clockPaused = true) and is only released by onUIStartButtonClicked.
Wall-clock time = (rallyStartTimeSecs + clock) modulo 86400. For the engine's tod.time, 0 corresponds to noon: seconds of the day = ((tod.time*24 + 12) % 24) * 3600.

Mission sequence: 'serviceOut', then for each stage 1 to 4 the road section then the stage, then the return road section, then 'serviceIn'. serviceOut and serviceIn are dummy entries (notActualMission = true).

Labels: TC0 at the first start (TC{n-1}B if startingSSNumber > 1), TC{n} for the road section before stage n, TC{n-1}A for the return road section. The schedule's ssLabel values are number strings ("1", "2"...); the displayed label is 'SS' .. ssLabel.

Event types (self.events[i].type): 'tc', 'ss_start', 'ss_stop', 'service_in'. Fields of an event: type, label, spName (name of the race path's start position), time (epoch, minute-aligned, nil for service_in), pos ({x,y,z}), missionId, missionIndex, canIncurLatePenalty, hideTimecardEntry, eventId, eventGroup, inServicePark, timecardIndex.

Penalties recorded in eventLog via addItem(event, clock, 'penalty', data): penaltyType = false_start, route_recalc, speeding (fixed 10 s), test_penalty, as well as the time penalties from loop/penalties (getTimingStatus: time_control_early, late...). 'time_control_early' penalties are removed when rallyEnableEarlyTimeControlPenalties is false.

Settings frozen at loop start (initSettings): rallyEnableFalseStarts, rallyRepairVehicleOnRecovery, rallyEnableEarlyTimeControlPenalties, rallyEnableTraffic (mission.lastUserSettings first, otherwise global settings); rallyShowStageApps is global. isNgrcMode = not repairVehicleOnRecovery.
Timers and stage times are in seconds; distances in km for distanceKm and totals; service park speed limit: 30 km/h (serviceParkSpeedLimitKph).
Minor bug: in init, UiColors.updateForLoop and rallyClockData.isNgrcMode are first called with self.isNgrcMode = nil (defined further down by initSettings); they are reapplied at the end of init.

Dead code: validateMissionSequence is not called (call commented out in buildMissionSequence); onRecalculatedRoute is entirely commented out (the recalculation counter is therefore never incremented by this hook); in _processRegularMission, ssLabel is first 'SS'..n then immediately overwritten by tostring(n).
getNextMissionId increments currentMissionIndex even when the end of the sequence is exceeded (the index stays past the last entry, so getCurrentMissionId returns nil).
updateScheduleData: timeDiffWithEnd uses nextEvent.time + 59 whereas eventWallClockEnd uses nextEvent.time + 60 (exclusive end).
extractMissionId uses the pattern '%((.+)%)$': returns what is between the last trailing parentheses of a "Name (id)" string (greedy), nil for '<none>' or a string without parentheses.

The module calls guihooks.trigger with 'Message', 'RallyClockSkipped' (oldTime, newTime, skippedSeconds) and 'RallyGameplayInteract' ({forceShowTimecard} or {}), and extensions.hook('onVehicleTeleportedToLastRoad', vehId).

C.desc: Loop manager instance. Main fields: missionId, missionDir, mission, missionName, fgVariables, missionSequence (list of ids), currentMissionIndex (0 = not started), schedule (one entry per mission of the sequence), events (linear list of events), nextEventIndex, clock, clockPaused, environmentStartTimeSecs, rallyStartTimeSecs, scheduleParams, skipParams, eventLog (RallyEventLog), streamData/rallyClockData/scheduleData/timecardData/uiColors (tables reused in place), roadSectionPenaltyKeeper, speedingDetector, totalSSCount, totalSSDistanceKm, totalRoadSectionDistanceKm, totalDistanceKm.

getServiceParkSpeedLimitKph.desc: Speed limit in the service park (30 km/h).

getServiceParkSpeedLimitDisplay.desc: Same limit formatted for display, in km/h or mph rounded to 5 depending on the uiUnitLength setting.

init.desc: Initializes the loop state: UI tables, environment start time, paused clock, schedule parameters (rally start 120 s after the full minute, 60 s of TC at the start line, 1 min slot) and skip parameters. If the mission provides fgVariables, builds the sequence and computes the schedule (calculateSchedule(true)), then reads the settings.

resolveMissionBoolSetting.desc: Reads a boolean setting first from mission.lastUserSettings, otherwise from settings.getValue, otherwise the default value.

resolveGlobalBoolSetting.desc: Reads a global boolean setting (settings.getValue) or the default value.

isDevTrafficDisabled.desc: True for a dev mission whose missionTypeData.devDisableTraffic is true.

returns.desc: true if traffic is disabled by the dev mission.

initSettings.desc: Freezes the loop settings: enableFalseStarts, repairVehicleOnRecovery, earlyTimeControlPenaltiesEnabled, trafficEnabled, showStageApps and isNgrcMode.

applyStartScreenSettings.desc: Applies the settings chosen on the start screen (rallyEnableFalseStarts, rallyRepairVehicleOnRecovery, rallyEnableEarlyTimeControlPenalties), updates isNgrcMode, the clock data and the colors.

values.desc: Table key -> boolean (ignored if not a table).

getRecoveryRepairVehicle.desc: Indicates whether the vehicle is repaired on recovery: always if rallyRepairVehicleOnRecovery, otherwise only outside a stage (hardcore/NGRC mode: no repair during a stage).

getTrafficEnabled.desc: Traffic enabled for the loop (false for a dev mission that disables it).

returns.desc: true if the stage apps are shown.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook called when settings change: rereads rallyShowStageApps.

extractMissionId.desc: Extracts the mission id from a fgVariable "Name (id)" value. Returns nil for nil or '<none>'.

_getExpectedScheduleLabel.desc: Expected label for a validation message: 'ROAD'..(roadSectionCount+1) for a road section, 'SS'..nextSSNumber for a stage, nil otherwise.

roadSectionCount.desc: Number of road sections already processed.

_getValidationHint.desc: Fix hint depending on the error message (word 'driveline' or 'race') and the mission type.

_addValidationIssue.desc: Adds a validation problem (blocking = true by default) and marks the schedule invalid (scheduleValid = false).

issue.desc: {type, missionId, missionType, label, message, hint, blocking}.

buildMissionSequence.desc: Builds missionSequence: 'serviceOut', then road section and stage of each stage 1 to 4 present, the return road section, then 'serviceIn'. Resets currentMissionIndex to 0.

validateMissionSequence.desc: Checks that the first mission is serviceOutMission. Not called in this version (call commented out).

calculateRallyStartTime.desc: Computes rallyStartTimeSecs: environment time rounded up to the next minute plus currentTimeToRallyStartSecs (120 s).

getRallyStartTimeSecs.desc: Rally start time in seconds of the day.

getRallyStartDurationSecs.desc: Duration between the environment time and the rally start.

getSlotSizeMinutes.desc: Size of the stage start rescheduling slot (1 minute).

returns.desc: Seconds of the day, nil if the schedule is not computed.

getWallClockDay.desc: Day number (1, 2...) of the wall clock.

getWallClockTimeFormatted.desc: Wall-clock time with seconds and tenths, followed by ", Day N".

getEpochTime.desc: Rally epoch time (negative before the start).

getEpochTimeFormatted.desc: Epoch formatted with sign, for example '+0:01:30'.

getClockPaused.desc: Indicates whether the clock is paused.

adjustClock.desc: Adds seconds to the clock (forward or backward).

getScheduledEventTime.desc: Looks in events for the scheduled time of the event whose spName equals eventName for the current mission.

returns.desc: Time in epoch, nil if not found.

calculateSchedule.desc: Computes the whole schedule: initializes the state, walks the sequence (serviceOut, real missions loaded via a temporary RallyManager, serviceIn), then builds the events and the timecards. Stops and empties events at the first mission failure.

includeDebugData.desc: true to keep the driveline point list (debug drawing).

returns.desc: false if a mission could not be processed.

getCurrentMissionId.desc: Id of the current mission of the sequence.

returns.desc: Id, nil if outside the sequence.

isInRoadSection.desc: True if the current schedule entry is a road section (roadSectionLabel defined).

isInSpecialStage.desc: True if the current entry is a timed stage (ssLabel defined).

shouldPenalizeSpeeding.desc: Speeding is penalized everywhere except during a stage.

getVoicepackPickForMission.desc: Resolves the voicepack to use via voicepack.resolveLoopVoicepackPick according to the rallyVoicepackPick setting.

returns.desc: Voicepack choice (inferred from code: value returned by voicepack.resolveLoopVoicepackPick).

getNextMissionId.desc: Moves to the next mission of the sequence and returns its id. Always increments the index, even past the end.

returns.desc: Id, nil if the sequence is empty or finished.

startNextMission.desc: Starts the next mission of the sequence from the current mission (instant startFromWithinMission) and raises missionExecutionTransferFlag. Fails if there is no foreground mission.

restartRallyLoop.desc: Restarts the rallyLoop mission from itself (instant) and raises missionExecutionTransferFlag.

gotoRallyLoopInstant.desc: Same as restartRallyLoop: instantly restarts the rallyLoop mission.

getSchedule.desc: Schedule table (one entry per mission of the sequence: tcIn/tcOut/ssStartLine/ssStopControl with pos, rot, name, label, time, speedLimitKph, distanceKm...).

isScheduleValid.desc: True as long as no blocking problem has been found.

hasValidationIssues.desc: True if there is at least one validation problem.

getNextEventIndex.desc: 1-based index of the next event to validate.

getCurrentRacePath.desc: Path of the current mission's race.race.json (nil for serviceOut/serviceIn).

advanceToNextEvent.desc: Moves to the next event (nextEventIndex = #events + 1 at the end).

filterTimingResultForSettings.desc: If early penalties are disabled, removes the 'time_control_early' penalties from the timing result and recomputes the total.

recordTimeCardEntry.desc: Records the passage at the current event. Checks that the event belongs to the current mission and that entryName == spName. Computes the time difference, logs the time penalties then a 'timecard' item (actualTime, timeDiff, timingResult, stageTimeSecs, splits for ss_stop), forces the timecard to be shown, reschedules the start line if arriving at a TC too close, updates the timecard then advances.

entryName.desc: Name of the start position crossed.

returns.desc: false if the recording is refused.

roundToNextMinute.desc: Rounds up to the next minute (delegates to scheduleUtils).

_findNextSSStartEvent.desc: Searches forward, from nextEventIndex, for the next 'ss_start' event.

_findPreviousSSStartEvent.desc: Searches backward for the 'ss_start' of the current stage.

_findNextTCEvent.desc: Searches forward for the next 'tc' event.

_findPreviousTCEvent.desc: Searches backward for the last 'tc' event.

_updateSSStartTime.desc: Changes the time of the next 'ss_start' (marks scheduledTimeWasAdjusted, increments rescheduleCount).

onlyIfLater.desc: If true, only changes if newTime is strictly later.

calculateStartLineTime.desc: Reschedules the stage start line based on the arrival time at the TC: next minute if at least 35 s remain in the minute, otherwise the full minute after arrival + 60 s. Only updates if the new time is later.

getTotalRoadSectionDistanceKm.desc: Total road section distance in km.

getTotalTime.desc: Total time (stages + penalties) of the log.

getTimeOfDay.desc: Environment time of day; falls back to {time = 0.92} (default start time for Italy) if core_environment returns nothing.

formatTimeFromSeconds.desc: Formats seconds of the day according to the 24 h format (USE_24H_FORMAT = true) or 12 h.

formatTimeFromSecondsString.desc: Like formatTimeFromSeconds but returns a string (with AM/PM if 12 h).

formatDuration.desc: Formats a duration as M:SS (absolute value).

formatStageTime.desc: Formats a stage time rounded to the tenth: S.T, M:SS.T or H:MM:SS.T depending on the duration.

getTimeOfDayFormatted.desc: Environment time of day, formatted (with seconds).

epochToWallClock.desc: Converts an epoch time to absolute seconds of the day (epoch + rallyStartTimeSecs, no modulo).

_calculateRoadSectionTimes.desc: Computes the times of a road section: TC_in = current time, TC_out = next minute of (current time + allocated time).

_calculateStageTimes.desc: Computes the times of a stage: start line = next minute of (current time + 60 s), stop = next minute of (start + allocated time).

_calculateRoadSectionLabels.desc: Determines the TC_in and TC_out labels of a road section: TC_in reuses the last TC for the first road section or the return road section; TC_out = 'TC'..nextSSNumber, or 'TC'..(nextSSNumber-1)..'A' for the return road section.

isServiceInRoadSection.desc: true for the return road section.

_addServiceOutToSchedule.desc: Adds the serviceOut entry to the schedule (TC0, or TC{n-1}B if continuing a rally) and returns its label.

_addServiceInToSchedule.desc: Adds the serviceIn entry (position of the serviceStallPos stall, with no time or TC).

_processRegularMission.desc: Loads a stage or road section mission via a temporary RallyManager (distance, allocated time, speed limit, TC/SS positions), determines its type, computes its labels and times, adds the entry to the schedule. On failure, adds a validation problem (scheduleLoadFailed or scheduleMissingStageStartPositions).

roadSectionCount.desc: Number of road sections already processed.

serviceInRoadSectionId.desc: Id of the return road section.

_initScheduleCalculation.desc: Resets schedule, events, validation, totals, computes the rally start time, initializes the (negative) clock and creates the roadSectionPenaltyKeeper and the speedingDetector.

returns.desc: Initial state of the computation (returnRoadSectionId, startingSSNumber, nextSSNumber, roadSectionCount, lastTCLabel, rallyStartTimeSecs, currentScheduleTimeSecs).

_postProcessSchedule.desc: Sets the trigger position of serviceOut (TC_in of the first road section), builds the events and the timecard data.

_buildEventsFromSchedule.desc: Builds the events list: a TC for serviceOut, a 'service_in', and for each stage 'ss_start' + 'ss_stop', for each road section a 'tc' (TC_out). Sets nextEventIndex to the first event with a time.

initTimecardData.desc: Builds the timecardData structure once (one entry per TC, plus one time entry per stage), with 'group-N' groups.

updateTimecardEntry.desc: Updates an event's timecard entry (recorded time, early/late/on-time status, stage time) from the log.

updateScheduleData.desc: Updates scheduleData in place for the next event: label, type, times of the scheduled minute, difference (negative timeDiff = early), current status and penalty, speed limit, service park, isSpeeding.

getRallyManager.desc: gameplay_rally RallyManager (cached); nil if the gameplay_rally extension is not loaded.

getWallClockTimeTable.desc: Wall-clock time with seconds as a {time, ampm} table.

updateRallyClockData.desc: Updates rallyClockData in place: time, day, total time, skip flags, early penalties enabled.

activateRallyModeInteractActionMap.desc: Enables (pushActionMap) or disables (popActionMap) the 'RallyModeInteract' action map.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: advances the clock by dtSim if it is not paused, evaluates the skip, enables the action map if skipping is possible, updates the roadSectionPenaltyKeeper and the speedingDetector (outside a stage, with a limit; strict mode for serviceIn and serviceOut).

onGuiUpdate.desc: Called by the GUI loop; does nothing (profiler instrumentation only).

evaluateSkip.desc: Evaluates whether the clock skip is possible: next 'tc' event, speed < 30 km/h (0.5 m/s hysteresis) and player distance to the TC between 5 m and 50 m. With early penalties, allows the manual skip; without, skips automatically.

setCanSkipTimeControls.desc: Sets the two time control skip flags.

canSkip.desc: True if a time control or countdown skip is possible.

skipToNextEvent.desc: Advances the clock to 1 s before the next TC and notifies the UI (RallyClockSkipped). Refuses if the next event is not a TC or if the target is not in the future.

returns.desc: true if the clock was advanced.

skipLiaisonForTesting.desc: Test tool: teleports the vehicle to distanceBefore m (50 by default) before the TC_out of the current road section, resynchronizes the rallyManager and sets the clock 1 s before the TC_out time.

onRallyModeInteract.desc: Hook of the interact action: skips to the next event if possible, otherwise triggers the UI event RallyGameplayInteract.

drawDebug.desc: Debug-draws the pins, TC/SS positions and optionally the trace and labels of each mission of the schedule (red for road sections, blue for stages, gray for services).

getMissionExecutionTransferFlag.desc: Flag indicating that execution is being transferred to another mission.

getDrawFlag.desc: Reads a drawing flag (for example showDebugInfo).

onRallyDataUpdated.desc: Receives data from the rallyManager or the nodes (activeState, vehicleProximity with distances rounded to the centimeter, countdownData) and stores it for the UI stream.

getStreamData.desc: Updates in place and returns the stream table sent to the UI: activeState (testActiveState in test mode), rallyClock, stageData (only during a stage, with label and km unit), vehicleProximity, countdownData, scheduleData, timecardData, penaltyData (penalty summary), showStageApps, translated missionName, uiColors.

setCountdownCanSkip.desc: Stores that the countdown can be skipped (updated by the countdown node).

canSkipCountdown.desc: True if the countdown can be skipped.

rescheduleNextSSStart.desc: Pushes the next 'ss_start' to the next slot (slotSizeMinutes, rounded to the minute) when the vehicle is not in position at -10 s. Always reschedules.

getSSRescheduleCount.desc: Number of reschedulings of the next 'ss_start'.

recordFalseStartPenalty.desc: Records a false start penalty for the next stage: counts the false starts already logged for the event and uses Penalties.calculateFalseStartPenalty(n).

returns.desc: false if there is no upcoming ss_start.

recordRouteRecalcPenalty.desc: Records a route recalculation penalty (penaltyType 'route_recalc') on the next TC and shows a "Route penalty recorded" message.

returns.desc: false if there is no upcoming TC.

recordSpeedingPenalty.desc: Records a fixed 10 s speeding penalty on the next 'tc' or 'service_in' event.

returns.desc: false if there is no eligible event.

recordTestPenalty.desc: Test tool: records a 'test_penalty' penalty (10 s by default) on the current event and shows a message.

returns.desc: false if amount <= 0 or no event.

getServiceOutTCPos.desc: Position {x,y,z} of the serviceOut trigger (TC_in of the first road section).

onUIStartButtonClicked.desc: Called when the player clicks Start: applies the start screen settings, resumes the clock, enables the restartMission button of core_recoveryPrompt and unfreezes the vehicle.

onRecalculatedRoute.desc: Route recalculation hook; currently has no effect (code commented out).

onCreatedRallyGroundMarkerRoute.desc: Hook called when the ground markers route is created: resets the roadSectionPenaltyKeeper.

trackRecovery.desc: Records a recovery ('recovery') or a flip ('flip'): advances the clock by RecoveryClockAdvance.getSeconds(type, inStage), also advances the time of day (RallyLoopTime.advancePlayingTime), notifies the UI and logs the item with the player's position.

onRallyRouteRecoveryComplete.desc: Hook at the end of a route recovery: stores data in lastRouteRecoveryData and logs.

setTestMode.desc: Enables or disables test mode; when disabling, resets currentActiveState to inactive.

setTestActiveState.desc: Sets the forced active state in test mode (and currentActiveState if test mode is active).
